source_notes.note: Hydrothermal reduction with CuCl2 or AgNO3, Te, 25% v/v aqueous ammonia and 85% v/v hydrazine hydrate in a Teflon-lined 50 mL autoclave filled up to 80%; exact charges/solution volumes and pressure are not reported. Natural cooling; filter and wash several times with distilled water; vacuum dry at 50 °C for 2 h.

claims.statement: Table 1 row at Cu:Te 1:1, 200 °C, 12 h lists Cu2.86Te2 with minor Te; CuTe is not listed.
Adjacent prose says higher reaction time and/or temperature increases CuTe while decreasing Te and Cu7Te5.

evidence_conflicts.resolution: Preserve both source statements; do not add CuTe to the exact table row.

remaining_gaps: Exact salt/Te charges, exact aqueous-ammonia and hydrazine volumes, addition/mixing sequence, pressure/atmosphere, ramp/cooling duration, wash count/volume, vacuum level and yield are unreported.
No source-assigned physical batch labels or exact crosswalk from phase-level XPS to recipe table rows.
Figure 3 morphology and size describe the Cu2-xTe 160 °C/8 h source population; exact physical batch and feed ratio are not repeated in the figure caption.
No unit-cell parameters, atomic coordinates, CIF/VESTA, or sample-specific coordinate assets.
Publisher permission for displayed source-figure crops remains unverified; separate release approval is pending.
